deep_dive.title: Aerial Manipulation in the Wild with Onboard Perception, Policy Learning, and Whole-Body Control
deep_dive.abstract: Aerial manipulation in outdoor environments remains challenging due to the simultaneous requirements of reliable state estimation, stable aerial motion, and precise manipulation under external disturbances. In this work, we present a real-world outdoor aerial manipulation framework that integrates imitation learning, onboard LiDAR-inertial state estimation, and whole-body model predictive control. A Diffusion Policy is trained from manipulation demonstrations to generate desired end-effector motions from onboard observations. These learned commands are executed by a whole-body MPC that jointly coordinates the aerial platform and manipulator to realize the desired end-effector trajectory. To eliminate reliance on external motion-capture infrastructure, the platform employs onboard LiDAR-inertial odometry for state estimation during outdoor operation. We validate the complete framework on a physical aerial manipulator and demonstrate successful execution of outdoor manipulation tasks. The experimental results show that demonstration-driven manipulation policies can be effectively integrated with onboard state estimation and model-based whole-body control to enable aerial manipulation beyond controlled indoor environments.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 户外空中操作需同时满足可靠状态估计、稳定飞行与抗扰精确操作，极具挑战。本文提出一套真实户外空中操作框架，融合模仿学习、机载激光雷达惯性状态估计与全身模型预测控制。其中扩散策略由操作演示训练生成期望末端运动，再由全身 MPC 联合协调飞行平台与机械臂执行。该工作实现了不依赖外部动捕的空中操作，推动了空中机械臂的实用化。

quick_skim.title: VLaRL: Augmenting Vision-Language-Action Models with Simulation-Trained Latent-Conditioned Residual RL
quick_skim.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad, instruction-conditioned manipulation behaviors, but their physical execution can remain imprecise during contact-rich interaction. Residual reinforcement learning (RL) can correct such errors while keeping the VLA frozen, but real-robot RL is costly and safety-critical. We propose VLA Latent-Conditioned RL (VLaRL), which enables residual RL for frozen VLAs to be trained in simulation and deployed on real robots without real-world RL or online adaptation. The key challenge is transferring the learned residual policy despite the visual gap between simulation and reality. Rather than requiring pixel-level visual correspondence, VLaRL uses the VLA's internal vision-language latent representation to condition residual control and as the sim-to-real transfer interface, and learns a lightweight mapper that transforms simulation-derived latents toward the real latent distribution. Across four contact-rich manipulation tasks and two VLA backbones, VLaRL improves real-world success in all task-backbone combinations, while controlled ablations demonstrate the importance of both latent conditioning and latent alignment for transferring simulation-trained residual control.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能提供广泛的指令条件操作行为，但在接触密集交互中执行精度不足。本文提出VLaRL，以VLA内部视觉语言表征为条件，在仿真中训练残差强化学习策略，再直接部署到真实机器人，无需真实世界RL或在线自适应。实验表明该方法能有效弥补仿真到现实的视觉差距，提升接触操作精度。其贡献在于为冻结VLA提供了一种安全、低成本的残差纠错范式。
